title: Camping
lines: Sam and Pam are camping at the pond.
Pam is fishing and Sam is resting.
Pam is yelling. A big fish is tugging!
Pam is slipping in the wet mud.
Sam is jumping up to grab Pam.
Both of them are pulling and pulling.
It lands in the pot with a thump.
Sam is grinning and Pam is glad.
Sam and Pam munch fish at camp.

questions.ask: What was Sam doing while Pam was fishing?
questions.listenFor: Resting. It is in the second line - send them back to it rather than telling them.
Pam was slipping in the mud and needed help. If they just say "the fish," ask "and what was happening to Pam?"

questions.ask: Do you think you would like camping by a pond? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. You are listening for a reason of their own - the fish, the mud, sleeping outside.
